title: Turán extremal graphs vs. Signless Laplacian spectral Turán extremal graphs
summary: Let $F$ be a graph with chromatic number $χ(F) = r+1$. Denote by $ex(n, F)$ and $Ex(n, F)$ the Turán number and the set of all extremal graphs for $F$, respectively. In addition, $ex_{ssp}(n, F)$ and $Ex_{ssp}(n, F)$ are the maximum signless Laplacian spectral radius of all $n$-vertex $F$-free graphs and the set of all $n$-vertex $F$-free graphs with signless Laplacian spectral radius $ex_{ssp}(n, F)$, respectively.
